pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_mastermind/lib/layoutStore.ts:118 parseLayout turns a JSON.parse failure of the persisted layout doc into null with no log, telemetry or user door, hydrate then substitutes emptyLayout(), and the next write-through overwrites the stored doc; that is a fallback with no door, which the standard says is not handling.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_mastermind/lib/layoutStore.ts:118 Bare catch returning null on a corrupt layout doc. The doc comment says 'never throws' but never says why the drop is safe, so no door and no declared-drop marker.

src/features/teams/sub_mastermind/lib/sceneStore.ts:239 A background family load goes to the silentCatch door (log, breadcrumb, swallow rollup) and also sets a failed/stale status that deriveScene renders as unknown, not as absent.

pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/StandardsScan.tsx:80 User-action failures (standards scan, applying standards, connecting, saving data links, starting a scan) are caught with a bare catch and shown only as a fixed toast, so the error is discarded and never reaches telemetry; the standard requires user-facing failures to reach the user and telemetry both.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/StandardsScan.tsx:80 User door only, no telemetry. The same shape repeats at ImprovePopover.tsx:69-70, ConnectorSection.tsx:64-65, DataLinksPopover.tsx:59-60 and ImprovePlanPanel.tsx:104-105, while ImprovePlanPanel.tsx:93 in the same context uses toastCatch correctly.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/ImprovePopover.tsx:70 Each call site writes its own generic failure copy and drops the error, so no classification and no category-derived suggestion. The mapping lives at call sites, not in the registry (resolveError/toastCatch).
src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/improve/ConnectorSection.tsx:45 Background reads route through silentCatch before falling back, so the fallback is paired with a door.

pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:29 parseStringArray turns a malformed file_paths JSON column into [] with no door, so a context silently loses its file list in the runtime join, and nothing records that the stored value was corrupt.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:29 Bare catch returning a fallback. 'Tolerantly' in the doc comment does not declare why the drop is safe.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:102 A failed groups/contexts read (the tab's primary content) gets telemetry only. Unlike the KPI and goals reads (kpisFailed/goalsFailed), it sets no failed flag, so the user sees an empty map that cannot be told apart from a project with no contexts.

src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/FactoryOverviewTab.tsx:63 A user action failure goes through toastCatch with no custom message, so the copy comes from the shared classifier and registry, not from the call site.
